Kiosks earn 1 money for each adjacent unique building, special enclosure, occupied standard enclosure, or pavilion; empty standard enclosures do not count, while empty special enclosures do. Income is appeal-based money, then kiosk income, then break-icon income on Sponsors and activated map bonuses. If multiple players take display cards during break income, process them clockwise from the break initiator (or first affected player clockwise from them), refilling the display after each player's income before the next affected player chooses.

grades.answer_evidence: At 2 conservation, choose an Action-card upgrade or activate an additional worker. At 5 and 8, choose 5 money or the Bonus token at that space. The first time anyone reaches 10, all players discard one Final Scoring card; if nobody reaches 10 before the end, everyone discards one before scoring. Check for game end at the end of your own turn or during a break when Appeal and Conservation counters are in the same scoring area or pass one another. Appeal gained during another player's turn waits until your own turn ends or a break, unless someone triggers the end sooner. The triggering player completes their turn, then all others take one final turn; if triggered during a break, every player takes one final turn. Each Final Scoring card can grant at most 4 conservation points. Victory points equal Appeal minus the lowest Appeal value in the scoring area containing your Conservation counter. Highest positive score wins; ties go to the player with most supported projects, then are shared.
